facts.business: MPL Plastics Limited was engaged in manufacturing Thermoware products but has closed down its operations at Silvassa and Pune plants and sold land and machinery during FY 2023-24, with management evaluating options including winding up the company.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has currently closed down its operations and it will have impact on the future operations of the company. These events or conditions indicate that a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. Our opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern as operations are closed down
No revenue from operations in FY 2025-26 and FY 2024-25
Negative net worth indicated by negative debt-equity ratio
Management evaluating options including winding up of the Company
Threats: There exists material uncertainty to start other business operations
